scope_note: The collaborative practice pair, repaired after the V7 round and re-sealed. The repair teaches the credential element as 247 CMR 16.02(1)(c) states it, including that a doctor of pharmacy degree qualifies only together with an agreement entered on or before 30 June 2017, and adds the 24-hour duty to copy an initial prescription, modification or discontinuation to the supervising physician. Nine additive rules carry the regulatory elements the sections had taken from the statute alone. SG-MA-CDTM-FOUNDATIONS has no actionable scope signal. SG-MA-CDTM-PRESCRIBING's two were declined: 105 CMR 700.003(F) is the Commissioner's emergency vaccine order regime, which is not one of the numbered requirements the 700.003(G) proviso attaches to the prescribing power.

prior_audit_reference.note: V7K rated the superseded SG-MA-CDTM-FOUNDATIONS hash MAJOR_REWRITE and the superseded SG-MA-CDTM-PRESCRIBING hash MINOR_EDIT, and drove this repair. Its dispositions bind none of the hashes frozen here, and it is excluded from the auditor package.
